path.desc: Closed complete surface; visible edge matches approved guide. Bun y134 and right stem y269.4 retain future motion exposure. No cutout is introduced.

head/topknot_bun; contour; Complete boundary and occlusion continuation; bun lower edge hides behind crown/front hair, earring top stem anchors inside ear. Clipped to the complete part surface; open lines are visible accents, closed contours delimit continuous fill.
